EDEN Deployment Audience Profiles
Version: 1.0
Status: PROFILE/POLICY — NOT UNIVERSAL CANON

PURPOSE
Defines deployment audience semantics. Named people, group membership and personal preferences are configuration data, not AppDevRules/edenOSrules.

PRIVATE — owner/personal deployment context and explicitly authorized personal resources.
FAMILY — explicitly authorized family audience/resources.
FRIENDS — explicitly authorized friend audience/resources.
PUBLIC — deliberately public audience/resources.

NESTING
FAMILY and FRIENDS may contain groups and named users.
Profiles inherit:
Audience base -> optional group defaults -> person -> optional user delta -> target-device adaptation.
Store only deltas where practical.

SETUP
Default: RECOMMENDED.
Optional: CUSTOM.
RECOMMENDED should minimize hassle: SIMPLE configuration, device-aware detection, reuse adequate existing software/providers, install only useful missing components, safe defaults, advanced controls hidden unless needed.
CUSTOM may progressively expose Apps/capabilities, preferences, integrations/providers, storage/data locations, language/locality, configuration depth, Development/Experimental access and advanced deployment options.

IMPORTANT
Audience != authentication != EDEN identity != authorization != data access.
Selecting FAMILY/FRIENDS does not automatically expose all resources.
Actual authorization remains explicit.
